description: Department of Trade and Investment Policy - Special Commodity Levy on Wheat Flour w.e.f. 14.12.2019
categorisation: This gazette content involves the imposition of a Special Commodity Levy under the Special Commodity Levy Act, No. 48 of 2007. It is a regulatory order that creates a new financial obligation (a levy) on specific commodities, which falls under the category of Legal/Regulatory matters. While it names Mahinda Rajapaksa as the Minister issuing the order, the primary purpose is to establish a regulatory framework and compliance requirement for commodity imports, not to detail his portfolio responsibilities or make a personnel announcement. Therefore, it meets the criteria for Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory) rather than a government personnel or hybrid classification.
